question: A glacier in Alaska has been retreating at an increasingly fast rate for several decades. Scientists take core samples from the ice and measure the concentration of carbon dioxide trapped in ancient air bubbles. They use this data to understand how CO2 concentrations have changed over ___ of years.
statement: A glacier in Alaska has been retreating at an increasingly fast rate for several decades. Scientists take core samples from the ice and measure the concentration of carbon dioxide trapped in ancient air bubbles. They use this data to understand how CO2 concentrations have changed over thousands of years.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A city planner is designing a new residential area. She decides to plant many trees along the streets. Among other benefits, the trees will reduce the urban ___ island effect by providing shade and cooling the air through transpiration.
statement: A city planner is designing a new residential area. She decides to plant many trees along the streets. Among other benefits, the trees will reduce the urban heat island effect by providing shade and cooling the air through transpiration.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is doing an experiment with two identical plants. She places one in direct sunlight and the other in shade. After two weeks, the plant in the sun is taller and has darker, thicker leaves. The shaded plant is taller and thinner as it is ___ for light.
statement: A student is doing an experiment with two identical plants. She places one in direct sunlight and the other in shade. After two weeks, the plant in the sun is taller and has darker, thicker leaves. The shaded plant is taller and thinner as it is reaching for light.

subject: General Knowledge
question: Scientists discover a new species of deep-sea shrimp that can survive extremely high temperatures near hydrothermal vents. These organisms are called ___ because they thrive in extreme conditions.
statement: Scientists discover a new species of deep-sea shrimp that can survive extremely high temperatures near hydrothermal vents. These organisms are called extremophiles because they thrive in extreme conditions.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is writing a report on ocean tides and learns that tides in some locations are much higher than in others. This is because the shape of the ___ and nearby coastlines can amplify or diminish tidal effects.
statement: A student is writing a report on ocean tides and learns that tides in some locations are much higher than in others. This is because the shape of the ocean floor and nearby coastlines can amplify or diminish tidal effects.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A person is standing on a train platform when a fast train passes without stopping. She notices she feels slightly pulled toward the train. This is because the fast-moving train creates a region of lower ___ beside it.
statement: A person is standing on a train platform when a fast train passes without stopping. She notices she feels slightly pulled toward the train. This is because the fast-moving train creates a region of lower air pressure beside it.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student notices that a copper coin left in a damp environment turns green over time. This happens because the copper reacts with oxygen and moisture to form copper ___, a green compound.
statement: A student notices that a copper coin left in a damp environment turns green over time. This happens because the copper reacts with oxygen and moisture to form copper carbonate, a green compound.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A paleontologist digs up a fossilized skeleton of an ancient horse that is much smaller than modern horses. She concludes that over millions of years, horses evolved to be ___ in order to survive changing environments.
statement: A paleontologist digs up a fossilized skeleton of an ancient horse that is much smaller than modern horses. She concludes that over millions of years, horses evolved to be larger in order to survive changing environments.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A researcher studying poverty and education finds that children from low-income families are more likely to drop out of school early. She recommends programs that provide free school meals, as children who are ___ have difficulty concentrating in class.
statement: A researcher studying poverty and education finds that children from low-income families are more likely to drop out of school early. She recommends programs that provide free school meals, as children who are hungry have difficulty concentrating in class.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A group of students is trying to lift a heavy rock using a metal rod as a lever. They discover that placing the fulcrum closer to the rock means they need to apply ___ force to lift it.
statement: A group of students is trying to lift a heavy rock using a metal rod as a lever. They discover that placing the fulcrum closer to the rock means they need to apply less force to lift it.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A biologist studying dolphins finds that they use a system of clicks and whistles to communicate. When a dolphin is separated from its group, it produces a specific call unique to itself, called a signature ___.
statement: A biologist studying dolphins finds that they use a system of clicks and whistles to communicate. When a dolphin is separated from its group, it produces a specific call unique to itself, called a signature whistle.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer tests two versions of a bicycle helmet. One is round and smooth, the other has many vents. The smooth helmet creates less air ___, making it faster for racing cyclists.
statement: An engineer tests two versions of a bicycle helmet. One is round and smooth, the other has many vents. The smooth helmet creates less air resistance, making it faster for racing cyclists.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student pours water into a narrow tube and notices the water surface is slightly curved upward at the edges. This curved surface is called a ___ and forms because water molecules are attracted to the glass.
statement: A student pours water into a narrow tube and notices the water surface is slightly curved upward at the edges. This curved surface is called a meniscus and forms because water molecules are attracted to the glass.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A wildlife photographer is tracking polar bears. She notices they are swimming further each year to find sea ice to rest on. This is because ___ is reducing the extent of Arctic sea ice.
statement: A wildlife photographer is tracking polar bears. She notices they are swimming further each year to find sea ice to rest on. This is because climate change is reducing the extent of Arctic sea ice.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A physics student rolls a ball along a flat surface and notices it slows down and stops even without any obstacle. He concludes that ___ between the ball and the surface gradually removes kinetic energy.
statement: A physics student rolls a ball along a flat surface and notices it slows down and stops even without any obstacle. He concludes that friction between the ball and the surface gradually removes kinetic energy.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A marine biologist discovers that coral reefs are bleaching and dying in an area where ocean temperature has risen. Bleaching occurs because the coral expels the ___ algae living inside its tissues.
statement: A marine biologist discovers that coral reefs are bleaching and dying in an area where ocean temperature has risen. Bleaching occurs because the coral expels the symbiotic algae living inside its tissues.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A mountaineer climbing a high peak notices that the snow at the top has become ice-like under pressure. Glaciologists explain that as snow accumulates and is compressed over many years, it turns into ___ ice.
statement: A mountaineer climbing a high peak notices that the snow at the top has become ice-like under pressure. Glaciologists explain that as snow accumulates and is compressed over many years, it turns into glacial ice.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is watching a documentary about how cave paintings were made by ancient humans. The narrator explains that the pigments used were made from natural minerals mixed with ___ to create a paste that could be applied to the cave walls.
statement: A student is watching a documentary about how cave paintings were made by ancient humans. The narrator explains that the pigments used were made from natural minerals mixed with animal fat to create a paste that could be applied to the cave walls.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A scientist testing a new drug finds that it is very effective at treating a disease in laboratory animals, but when tested in humans it has almost no effect. This is because the human ___ metabolizes the drug differently.
statement: A scientist testing a new drug finds that it is very effective at treating a disease in laboratory animals, but when tested in humans it has almost no effect. This is because the human body metabolizes the drug differently.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A botanist studying plant behavior in arid environments finds that some cacti have developed very deep root systems. These deep roots allow the cacti to access ___ found far below the desert surface.
statement: A botanist studying plant behavior in arid environments finds that some cacti have developed very deep root systems. These deep roots allow the cacti to access groundwater found far below the desert surface.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A climate scientist notices that a particular region's average temperature has risen by two degrees Celsius over the past century. She attributes this to increased concentrations of ___ gases in the atmosphere.
statement: A climate scientist notices that a particular region's average temperature has risen by two degrees Celsius over the past century. She attributes this to increased concentrations of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A sailor is navigating a small boat and notices that the wind is consistently blowing from west to east in the temperate zone where she is sailing. She knows this is because of the ___ winds that dominate that part of the globe.
statement: A sailor is navigating a small boat and notices that the wind is consistently blowing from west to east in the temperate zone where she is sailing. She knows this is because of the westerly winds that dominate that part of the globe.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying genetics learns that some traits skip generations. He discovers this is because recessive traits are only expressed when an individual inherits two copies of the ___ allele.
statement: A student studying genetics learns that some traits skip generations. He discovers this is because recessive traits are only expressed when an individual inherits two copies of the recessive allele.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An environmentalist measuring plastic waste in the ocean discovers tiny fragments less than 5 millimeters in size. These fragments, known as ___, come from larger plastic items that have broken down over time.
statement: An environmentalist measuring plastic waste in the ocean discovers tiny fragments less than 5 millimeters in size. These fragments, known as microplastics, come from larger plastic items that have broken down over time.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A nurse explains to her patient that the skin is the body's first line of defense against ___ because it acts as a physical barrier.
statement: A nurse explains to her patient that the skin is the body's first line of defense against infection because it acts as a physical barrier.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A geologist is mapping an area and finds that the rock layers are tilted and folded. She concludes that the area was subjected to tremendous ___ forces from tectonic activity in the past.
statement: A geologist is mapping an area and finds that the rock layers are tilted and folded. She concludes that the area was subjected to tremendous compressional forces from tectonic activity in the past.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A marine engineer is designing anchors for large ships. She needs anchors that can hold the ship in place even in strong currents. She knows the anchor must be heavy enough so that the force of ___ holds the ship in position.
statement: A marine engineer is designing anchors for large ships. She needs anchors that can hold the ship in place even in strong currents. She knows the anchor must be heavy enough so that the force of gravity holds the ship in position.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student learning about the nervous system discovers that nerve signals travel along neurons using a combination of electrical and chemical signals. The chemical signals that cross the gap between neurons are called ___.
statement: A student learning about the nervous system discovers that nerve signals travel along neurons using a combination of electrical and chemical signals. The chemical signals that cross the gap between neurons are called neurotransmitters.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A zoologist studying emperor penguins in Antarctica finds that the penguins huddle together in enormous groups during the coldest months. The penguins at the center of the huddle are warmer because they are surrounded by other penguins that block the ___.
statement: A zoologist studying emperor penguins in Antarctica finds that the penguins huddle together in enormous groups during the coldest months. The penguins at the center of the huddle are warmer because they are surrounded by other penguins that block the wind.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer is designing a water treatment plant. She explains that one step in the process involves adding a chemical that causes tiny particles of dirt and bacteria to clump together. This process is called ___ and makes the particles easier to remove.
statement: An engineer is designing a water treatment plant. She explains that one step in the process involves adding a chemical that causes tiny particles of dirt and bacteria to clump together. This process is called flocculation and makes the particles easier to remove.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is investigating why leaves change color in autumn. Her teacher explains that as days get shorter and temperatures fall, trees stop producing ___, the green pigment that normally masks the other colors in the leaves.
statement: A student is investigating why leaves change color in autumn. Her teacher explains that as days get shorter and temperatures fall, trees stop producing chlorophyll, the green pigment that normally masks the other colors in the leaves.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A physics teacher demonstrates how a spinning top stays upright while spinning. She explains that the spinning top resists falling over because of a property called angular ___.
statement: A physics teacher demonstrates how a spinning top stays upright while spinning. She explains that the spinning top resists falling over because of a property called angular momentum.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student reads that Earth's magnetic poles are not at the same location as the geographic poles. A compass needle therefore points to ___ north rather than true north.
statement: A student reads that Earth's magnetic poles are not at the same location as the geographic poles. A compass needle therefore points to magnetic north rather than true north.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A diver is exploring a coral reef at a depth of 20 meters. She notices that colors appear different from at the surface because ___ wavelengths of light are absorbed by the water before they reach this depth.
statement: A diver is exploring a coral reef at a depth of 20 meters. She notices that colors appear different from at the surface because red wavelengths of light are absorbed by the water before they reach this depth.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A meteorologist is explaining to students why clouds don't fall out of the sky even though they contain water. She says the tiny water droplets are so small and light that even gentle upward air ___ keep them aloft.
statement: A meteorologist is explaining to students why clouds don't fall out of the sky even though they contain water. She says the tiny water droplets are so small and light that even gentle upward air currents keep them aloft.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is designing a model wind turbine for a science project. She discovers that increasing the length of the blades significantly increases the amount of electricity generated. This is because longer blades sweep a larger ___ and capture more wind energy.
statement: A student is designing a model wind turbine for a science project. She discovers that increasing the length of the blades significantly increases the amount of electricity generated. This is because longer blades sweep a larger area and capture more wind energy.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A scientist is tracking the movement of monarch butterflies migrating from Canada to Mexico. She discovers that the butterflies use the position of the ___ as a compass to navigate southward.
statement: A scientist is tracking the movement of monarch butterflies migrating from Canada to Mexico. She discovers that the butterflies use the position of the Sun as a compass to navigate southward.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A volcanologist is studying a dormant volcano. She drills a core sample from the surrounding rock and finds alternating layers of lava and ash deposits. She concludes the volcano has ___ several times over its history.
statement: A volcanologist is studying a dormant volcano. She drills a core sample from the surrounding rock and finds alternating layers of lava and ash deposits. She concludes the volcano has erupted several times over its history.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is studying the water cycle and learns that large bodies of water release water vapor into the atmosphere through ___.
statement: A student is studying the water cycle and learns that large bodies of water release water vapor into the atmosphere through evaporation.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A biologist places a red blood cell in a solution that is more concentrated than the cell's interior. She observes that the cell shrivels up. This happens because water moves out of the cell by ___, from a region of high water concentration to low.
statement: A biologist places a red blood cell in a solution that is more concentrated than the cell's interior. She observes that the cell shrivels up. This happens because water moves out of the cell by osmosis, from a region of high water concentration to low.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student doing a chemistry experiment accidentally mixes two solutions and a gas is produced that smells of rotten eggs. The teacher recognizes this as ___ gas, which indicates a reaction involving sulfur compounds.
statement: A student doing a chemistry experiment accidentally mixes two solutions and a gas is produced that smells of rotten eggs. The teacher recognizes this as hydrogen sulfide gas, which indicates a reaction involving sulfur compounds.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer designing a space shuttle knows that during re-entry into Earth's atmosphere, the shuttle heats up enormously due to ___ with air molecules.
statement: An engineer designing a space shuttle knows that during re-entry into Earth's atmosphere, the shuttle heats up enormously due to friction with air molecules.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A teacher explains to students that the color of a flame can tell us about its temperature. A blue flame is ___ than a yellow or orange flame.
statement: A teacher explains to students that the color of a flame can tell us about its temperature. A blue flame is hotter than a yellow or orange flame.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A nurse is checking a patient's blood pressure and finds it is very high. She warns the patient that sustained high blood pressure can damage the ___ over time and increase the risk of heart attack and stroke.
statement: A nurse is checking a patient's blood pressure and finds it is very high. She warns the patient that sustained high blood pressure can damage the arteries over time and increase the risk of heart attack and stroke.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A scientist analyzes soil samples from a field and finds that it contains very little organic matter. She recommends adding ___ to the soil to improve its structure and fertility.
statement: A scientist analyzes soil samples from a field and finds that it contains very little organic matter. She recommends adding compost to the soil to improve its structure and fertility.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An oceanographer studying underwater sound transmission discovers that blue whales can communicate with each other over distances of hundreds of miles. This is possible because sound travels ___ in water than in air.
statement: An oceanographer studying underwater sound transmission discovers that blue whales can communicate with each other over distances of hundreds of miles. This is possible because sound travels faster in water than in air.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A veterinarian treating a dog that has ingested chocolate explains to the owner that chocolate contains a compound called theobromine, which is ___ to dogs but safe for humans.
statement: A veterinarian treating a dog that has ingested chocolate explains to the owner that chocolate contains a compound called theobromine, which is toxic to dogs but safe for humans.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying bacteria in a petri dish notices that the bacteria closest to a mold colony have died. She is observing the same phenomenon that Alexander Fleming noticed when he discovered ___.
statement: A student studying bacteria in a petri dish notices that the bacteria closest to a mold colony have died. She is observing the same phenomenon that Alexander Fleming noticed when he discovered penicillin.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student investigating electricity builds a simple circuit with a battery, a wire, and a bulb. The bulb lights up only when the circuit forms a ___ loop.
statement: A student investigating electricity builds a simple circuit with a battery, a wire, and a bulb. The bulb lights up only when the circuit forms a complete loop.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student learning about density fills a tall glass with oil, water, and honey. Each liquid settles into a separate layer, with honey on the bottom, water in the middle, and oil on top. This happens because each liquid has a different ___.
statement: A student learning about density fills a tall glass with oil, water, and honey. Each liquid settles into a separate layer, with honey on the bottom, water in the middle, and oil on top. This happens because each liquid has a different density.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A group of students is building a model bridge out of dry spaghetti. They find that the bridge can hold more weight when the spaghetti is arranged in a triangle pattern because triangles distribute ___ effectively.
statement: A group of students is building a model bridge out of dry spaghetti. They find that the bridge can hold more weight when the spaghetti is arranged in a triangle pattern because triangles distribute force effectively.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A park ranger warns hikers that approaching a bear cub could be very dangerous because the mother bear is likely ___ nearby.
statement: A park ranger warns hikers that approaching a bear cub could be very dangerous because the mother bear is likely present nearby.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student researching deforestation learns that the Amazon rainforest produces 20 percent of the world's ___ and is sometimes called the lungs of the planet.
statement: A student researching deforestation learns that the Amazon rainforest produces 20 percent of the world's oxygen and is sometimes called the lungs of the planet.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A meteorologist explains that the jet stream is a ribbon of fast-moving air high in the atmosphere that influences weather patterns. When the jet stream shifts southward in winter, it can bring cold ___ to regions that normally have mild winters.
statement: A meteorologist explains that the jet stream is a ribbon of fast-moving air high in the atmosphere that influences weather patterns. When the jet stream shifts southward in winter, it can bring cold air to regions that normally have mild winters.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A scientist studying fossils in a desert finds that many of the fossils are of marine animals. She concludes that the area must have once been covered by ___.
statement: A scientist studying fossils in a desert finds that many of the fossils are of marine animals. She concludes that the area must have once been covered by an ocean.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is studying how vaccines work. She learns that a vaccine introduces a harmless or weakened version of a pathogen into the body, causing the immune system to produce ___ without the person getting sick.
statement: A student is studying how vaccines work. She learns that a vaccine introduces a harmless or weakened version of a pathogen into the body, causing the immune system to produce antibodies without the person getting sick.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An ornithologist studying hummingbirds finds that they must eat almost constantly because their incredibly fast ___ rate requires a huge amount of energy.
statement: An ornithologist studying hummingbirds finds that they must eat almost constantly because their incredibly fast metabolism rate requires a huge amount of energy.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A biologist studying mangrove forests along a coastline finds that these trees act as a barrier, protecting the land behind them from ___ erosion caused by waves and storm surges.
statement: A biologist studying mangrove forests along a coastline finds that these trees act as a barrier, protecting the land behind them from coastal erosion caused by waves and storm surges.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student investigating sound insulation tests several materials by placing them between a speaker and a microphone. She finds that thick, soft materials reduce sound transmission the most because they ___ the sound waves rather than reflecting them.
statement: A student investigating sound insulation tests several materials by placing them between a speaker and a microphone. She finds that thick, soft materials reduce sound transmission the most because they absorb the sound waves rather than reflecting them.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A researcher studying tropical deforestation finds that areas of cleared rainforest often become barren wastelands within a few years because the thin tropical ___ is quickly washed away by rain.
statement: A researcher studying tropical deforestation finds that areas of cleared rainforest often become barren wastelands within a few years because the thin tropical topsoil is quickly washed away by rain.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A chef discovers that adding a small amount of baking soda to vegetables when cooking them keeps the vegetables a brighter green color. This is because baking soda makes the cooking water ___, which helps preserve the chlorophyll.
statement: A chef discovers that adding a small amount of baking soda to vegetables when cooking them keeps the vegetables a brighter green color. This is because baking soda makes the cooking water alkaline, which helps preserve the chlorophyll.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A marine biologist observes that sea otters off the California coast spend a great deal of time floating on their backs, wrapping themselves in ___. She explains they do this to prevent themselves from floating away while they sleep.
statement: A marine biologist observes that sea otters off the California coast spend a great deal of time floating on their backs, wrapping themselves in kelp. She explains they do this to prevent themselves from floating away while they sleep.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A chemistry teacher demonstrates the reaction between sodium and water to her class. The sodium skids across the water's surface and eventually ignites. She explains this happens because the reaction is ___ and releases a large amount of heat.
statement: A chemistry teacher demonstrates the reaction between sodium and water to her class. The sodium skids across the water's surface and eventually ignites. She explains this happens because the reaction is exothermic and releases a large amount of heat.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A geographer studying a river delta notices that the delta is growing each year as sediment is deposited at the river's mouth. However, in areas where dams have been built upstream, the delta is actually ___ because the dams trap the sediment.
statement: A geographer studying a river delta notices that the delta is growing each year as sediment is deposited at the river's mouth. However, in areas where dams have been built upstream, the delta is actually shrinking because the dams trap the sediment.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An ecologist studying a grassland ecosystem finds that the diversity of plant species is highest in areas with moderate levels of disturbance, such as occasional grazing. She concludes that some level of disturbance actually ___ biodiversity.
statement: An ecologist studying a grassland ecosystem finds that the diversity of plant species is highest in areas with moderate levels of disturbance, such as occasional grazing. She concludes that some level of disturbance actually increases biodiversity.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A nurse explains to a patient why people feel cold when they have a fever. She says the brain has raised the body's target temperature, so the body tries to generate more ___ by shivering, making the person feel cold even as their temperature rises.
statement: A nurse explains to a patient why people feel cold when they have a fever. She says the brain has raised the body's target temperature, so the body tries to generate more heat by shivering, making the person feel cold even as their temperature rises.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student conducting a physics experiment finds that when she doubles the height from which she drops a ball, it hits the floor with more ___ than when dropped from the original height.
statement: A student conducting a physics experiment finds that when she doubles the height from which she drops a ball, it hits the floor with more force than when dropped from the original height.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student investigating magnetism brings a magnet near a pile of mixed coins and finds that only some coins stick to the magnet. She concludes that the coins that stick must contain ___.
statement: A student investigating magnetism brings a magnet near a pile of mixed coins and finds that only some coins stick to the magnet. She concludes that the coins that stick must contain iron or nickel.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A person leaves a glass of cold water on a table on a humid day. After a while, droplets of water form on the outside of the glass. The person correctly concludes that the water on the outside came from the ___ in the surrounding air.
statement: A person leaves a glass of cold water on a table on a humid day. After a while, droplets of water form on the outside of the glass. The person correctly concludes that the water on the outside came from the water vapor in the surrounding air.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A construction worker is drilling into concrete and must wear protective earmuffs. Without the earmuffs, the prolonged exposure to the high-decibel noise could cause permanent ___ loss.
statement: A construction worker is drilling into concrete and must wear protective earmuffs. Without the earmuffs, the prolonged exposure to the high-decibel noise could cause permanent hearing loss.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A biologist notices that two populations of the same species of bird were separated by a large mountain range thousands of years ago. Today they look different enough that scientists classify them as different species. This process of species formation is called ___.
statement: A biologist notices that two populations of the same species of bird were separated by a large mountain range thousands of years ago. Today they look different enough that scientists classify them as different species. This process of species formation is called speciation.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A homeowner is choosing insulation for their roof. The salesman explains that higher insulation ratings mean less heat escapes in winter and less enters in summer. The primary purpose of roof insulation is to reduce ___ of heat.
statement: A homeowner is choosing insulation for their roof. The salesman explains that higher insulation ratings mean less heat escapes in winter and less enters in summer. The primary purpose of roof insulation is to reduce transfer of heat.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A ship captain notices that the ship rides higher in the ocean than in a freshwater river, even with the same cargo. This is because ocean water is ___ than freshwater and provides more buoyancy.
statement: A ship captain notices that the ship rides higher in the ocean than in a freshwater river, even with the same cargo. This is because ocean water is denser than freshwater and provides more buoyancy.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An ornithologist studying migratory birds finds that birds kept in cages still become restless and try to fly south in autumn. She concludes that the migration instinct is ___ and does not require learning.
statement: An ornithologist studying migratory birds finds that birds kept in cages still become restless and try to fly south in autumn. She concludes that the migration instinct is innate and does not require learning.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student heats an airtight metal can until steam comes out. She then quickly seals it and places it in cold water. The can immediately crumples. This happened because the steam condensed, reducing the ___ inside the can.
statement: A student heats an airtight metal can until steam comes out. She then quickly seals it and places it in cold water. The can immediately crumples. This happened because the steam condensed, reducing the air pressure inside the can.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A researcher studying the Great Barrier Reef notes that certain sections are now covered in algae and have very few living corals. She determines that agricultural runoff is adding excess nutrients to the water, causing algae to ___ and smother the coral.
statement: A researcher studying the Great Barrier Reef notes that certain sections are now covered in algae and have very few living corals. She determines that agricultural runoff is adding excess nutrients to the water, causing algae to overgrow and smother the coral.

subject: General Knowledge
question: Two ice skaters of equal mass push off each other and glide apart. Skater A is pushed hard and moves quickly. Skater B moves in the opposite direction at the ___ speed as Skater A, demonstrating Newton's Third Law.
statement: Two ice skaters of equal mass push off each other and glide apart. Skater A is pushed hard and moves quickly. Skater B moves in the opposite direction at the same speed as Skater A, demonstrating Newton's Third Law.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A nurse explains to a patient why they need to take the full course of antibiotics even when they feel better. She says stopping early can allow the most ___ bacteria to survive and multiply, leading to antibiotic resistance.
statement: A nurse explains to a patient why they need to take the full course of antibiotics even when they feel better. She says stopping early can allow the most resistant bacteria to survive and multiply, leading to antibiotic resistance.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An archaeologist uncovers the remains of an ancient settlement near a river. She concludes that early humans built settlements near rivers because rivers provided ___, fertile soil, and a means of transportation.
statement: An archaeologist uncovers the remains of an ancient settlement near a river. She concludes that early humans built settlements near rivers because rivers provided freshwater, fertile soil, and a means of transportation.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student discovers that yeast added to grape juice at warm temperatures produces alcohol and carbon dioxide. When she cools the mixture to near zero degrees, the yeast becomes ___ and fermentation stops.
statement: A student discovers that yeast added to grape juice at warm temperatures produces alcohol and carbon dioxide. When she cools the mixture to near zero degrees, the yeast becomes inactive and fermentation stops.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A physicist measures that a spring stretches by 2 cm for each additional 1 Newton of force. When she applies 5 Newtons, the spring should stretch by ___ cm, according to Hooke's Law.
statement: A physicist measures that a spring stretches by 2 cm for each additional 1 Newton of force. When she applies 5 Newtons, the spring should stretch by 10 cm, according to Hooke's Law.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A botanist studying rainforest plants discovers that the leaves of plants on the forest floor are much larger than those of plants in the canopy. She concludes that the large leaves help capture more ___ in the dim understory.
statement: A botanist studying rainforest plants discovers that the leaves of plants on the forest floor are much larger than those of plants in the canopy. She concludes that the large leaves help capture more light in the dim understory.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A researcher testing a new painkiller divides patients into two groups. One group receives the real medication, the other receives a sugar pill. Neither group knows which they received. This type of study is called a ___ trial.
statement: A researcher testing a new painkiller divides patients into two groups. One group receives the real medication, the other receives a sugar pill. Neither group knows which they received. This type of study is called a double-blind trial.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A herpetologist studying reptile behavior notices that lizards in cooler regions spend more time basking in the sun. She explains this is because reptiles are ___ and need the sun's heat to warm their bodies enough to be active.
statement: A herpetologist studying reptile behavior notices that lizards in cooler regions spend more time basking in the sun. She explains this is because reptiles are cold-blooded and need the sun's heat to warm their bodies enough to be active.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A ship sends a distress signal using a flare gun. The flare rises high into the sky and produces a bright red light. Red is chosen for the flare because the human eye is particularly ___ to red light in dark conditions.
statement: A ship sends a distress signal using a flare gun. The flare rises high into the sky and produces a bright red light. Red is chosen for the flare because the human eye is particularly sensitive to red light in dark conditions.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying photosynthesis measures the rate of oxygen production by a plant under different colored lights. She finds that the plant produces the most oxygen under ___ light.
statement: A student studying photosynthesis measures the rate of oxygen production by a plant under different colored lights. She finds that the plant produces the most oxygen under red and blue light.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A geologist notices that rocks in a mountainous region show signs of extreme heat and pressure without evidence of melting. She correctly identifies these as ___ rocks.
statement: A geologist notices that rocks in a mountainous region show signs of extreme heat and pressure without evidence of melting. She correctly identifies these as metamorphic rocks.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A runner competing in a hot weather marathon drinks both water and sports drinks with electrolytes. The electrolytes are important because sweating causes loss of important ___ salts that the body needs to function.
statement: A runner competing in a hot weather marathon drinks both water and sports drinks with electrolytes. The electrolytes are important because sweating causes loss of important mineral salts that the body needs to function.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student fills one balloon with helium and another with carbon dioxide. When released, the helium balloon floats but the carbon dioxide balloon falls to the floor. This is because helium is ___ than air, while carbon dioxide is heavier.
statement: A student fills one balloon with helium and another with carbon dioxide. When released, the helium balloon floats but the carbon dioxide balloon falls to the floor. This is because helium is lighter than air, while carbon dioxide is heavier.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A conservationist studying a population of endangered mountain gorillas finds that their habitat is shrinking each year due to farming expansion. As their habitat shrinks, the gorillas are forced into smaller areas with less ___ and more competition.
statement: A conservationist studying a population of endangered mountain gorillas finds that their habitat is shrinking each year due to farming expansion. As their habitat shrinks, the gorillas are forced into smaller areas with less food and more competition.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A teacher demonstrating density fills a tank with water and places several objects in it. Some float and some sink. She explains that objects float when they are less ___ than water.
statement: A teacher demonstrating density fills a tank with water and places several objects in it. Some float and some sink. She explains that objects float when they are less dense than water.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer is designing a satellite dish. The dish is shaped like a large curved bowl. The curved shape focuses incoming radio waves onto a receiver in the ___ of the dish.
statement: An engineer is designing a satellite dish. The dish is shaped like a large curved bowl. The curved shape focuses incoming radio waves onto a receiver in the center of the dish.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student investigating the reaction of metals with acid places strips of iron, copper, zinc, and magnesium into hydrochloric acid. She observes that magnesium reacts most vigorously and copper barely reacts at all. She concludes that magnesium is more chemically ___ than copper.
statement: A student investigating the reaction of metals with acid places strips of iron, copper, zinc, and magnesium into hydrochloric acid. She observes that magnesium reacts most vigorously and copper barely reacts at all. She concludes that magnesium is more chemically reactive than copper.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying geology learns that the Rocky Mountains and the Himalayan mountains were both formed by the ___ of tectonic plates.
statement: A student studying geology learns that the Rocky Mountains and the Himalayan mountains were both formed by the collision of tectonic plates.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A doctor explains to a patient that their kidneys are not working properly. The kidneys' primary function is to filter ___ from the blood and excrete it as urine.
statement: A doctor explains to a patient that their kidneys are not working properly. The kidneys' primary function is to filter waste products from the blood and excrete it as urine.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student drops a pencil and it falls to the floor. If the student were in outer space far from any planet, the pencil would not fall because there would be no ___ to pull it downward.
statement: A student drops a pencil and it falls to the floor. If the student were in outer space far from any planet, the pencil would not fall because there would be no gravity to pull it downward.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A wildlife biologist finds that a population of rabbits on an island is completely white, even though their mainland cousins are brown. She hypothesizes that the white color evolved because the island is covered in ___ for much of the year.
statement: A wildlife biologist finds that a population of rabbits on an island is completely white, even though their mainland cousins are brown. She hypothesizes that the white color evolved because the island is covered in snow for much of the year.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer is testing the strength of two bridges, one made of steel and one made of wood. The steel bridge can support ten times more weight before it breaks. This shows that steel has a greater ___ strength than wood.
statement: An engineer is testing the strength of two bridges, one made of steel and one made of wood. The steel bridge can support ten times more weight before it breaks. This shows that steel has a greater tensile strength than wood.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student reads that the speed of light is 300,000 km per second. She calculates that light from the Moon takes about 1.3 seconds to reach Earth. This means the Moon is approximately ___ km away.
statement: A student reads that the speed of light is 300,000 km per second. She calculates that light from the Moon takes about 1.3 seconds to reach Earth. This means the Moon is approximately 390,000 km away.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A pharmacist explains to a customer that they should not take two medications together because they can interact and create a harmful ___ substance.
statement: A pharmacist explains to a customer that they should not take two medications together because they can interact and create a harmful toxic substance.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A paleoclimatologist studying ancient ice cores finds trapped air bubbles that contain high concentrations of CO2 from thousands of years ago. She notes these high-CO2 periods correspond with ___ global temperatures.
statement: A paleoclimatologist studying ancient ice cores finds trapped air bubbles that contain high concentrations of CO2 from thousands of years ago. She notes these high-CO2 periods correspond with higher global temperatures.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying optics is surprised to learn that the image she sees in a flat mirror appears to be ___ the mirror's surface, even though there is nothing there.
statement: A student studying optics is surprised to learn that the image she sees in a flat mirror appears to be behind the mirror's surface, even though there is nothing there.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A chemist is developing a new adhesive. She finds that the adhesive works best when both surfaces are clean and free of oil. Oil prevents the adhesive from forming a strong ___ with the surface.
statement: A chemist is developing a new adhesive. She finds that the adhesive works best when both surfaces are clean and free of oil. Oil prevents the adhesive from forming a strong bond with the surface.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student learning about the food chain realizes that it takes ten times the amount of plant material to support one unit of herbivore biomass, and ten times the herbivore biomass to support one unit of carnivore. This means carnivores at the top of the food chain are always the ___ in number.
statement: A student learning about the food chain realizes that it takes ten times the amount of plant material to support one unit of herbivore biomass, and ten times the herbivore biomass to support one unit of carnivore. This means carnivores at the top of the food chain are always the fewest in number.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A city experiences severe air pollution from car emissions. A government study shows that the highest pollution levels occur during ___ hour traffic.
statement: A city experiences severe air pollution from car emissions. A government study shows that the highest pollution levels occur during rush hour traffic.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An entomologist studying ants discovers that they farm aphids to collect a sugary fluid called honeydew. In return, the ants protect the aphids from ___ and other threats.
statement: An entomologist studying ants discovers that they farm aphids to collect a sugary fluid called honeydew. In return, the ants protect the aphids from predators and other threats.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A person who is colorblind cannot distinguish between red and green light. This is because the ___ cells in their eyes that detect these colors are absent or not functioning.
statement: A person who is colorblind cannot distinguish between red and green light. This is because the cone cells in their eyes that detect these colors are absent or not functioning.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A historian studying ancient trade routes finds that the same goods, such as spices and silk, appear in many distant civilizations. She concludes that early humans had well-developed ___ networks that connected different parts of the world.
statement: A historian studying ancient trade routes finds that the same goods, such as spices and silk, appear in many distant civilizations. She concludes that early humans had well-developed trade networks that connected different parts of the world.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is growing bean plants in small pots of soil. She notices that after a few weeks, the plants stop growing even though she waters them regularly. She suspects the soil has been ___ of nutrients by the growing plants.
statement: A student is growing bean plants in small pots of soil. She notices that after a few weeks, the plants stop growing even though she waters them regularly. She suspects the soil has been depleted of nutrients by the growing plants.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A physicist is studying the behavior of gases. She finds that when she decreases the volume of a gas while keeping temperature constant, the ___ increases, following Boyle's Law.
statement: A physicist is studying the behavior of gases. She finds that when she decreases the volume of a gas while keeping temperature constant, the pressure increases, following Boyle's Law.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A marine biologist discovers a colony of tube worms living around a hydrothermal vent on the ocean floor. She is surprised because there is no sunlight at this depth. The food chain here is based on chemosynthesis, where bacteria get energy from ___ rather than sunlight.
statement: A marine biologist discovers a colony of tube worms living around a hydrothermal vent on the ocean floor. She is surprised because there is no sunlight at this depth. The food chain here is based on chemosynthesis, where bacteria get energy from chemicals rather than sunlight.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is studying the properties of waves. She discovers that as the frequency of a wave increases, its wavelength ___.
statement: A student is studying the properties of waves. She discovers that as the frequency of a wave increases, its wavelength decreases.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A chef is making caramel by heating sugar. As the sugar heats to high temperatures, it changes from white crystals to a brown liquid with a distinctive flavor. This change is a ___ change, as a new substance with different properties is formed.
statement: A chef is making caramel by heating sugar. As the sugar heats to high temperatures, it changes from white crystals to a brown liquid with a distinctive flavor. This change is a chemical change, as a new substance with different properties is formed.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An archaeologist studying an ancient site finds evidence of charcoal and ash in a circular area. She determines this was likely used as a ___ by the people who lived there.
statement: An archaeologist studying an ancient site finds evidence of charcoal and ash in a circular area. She determines this was likely used as a fire pit by the people who lived there.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student investigates why metal railings on a bridge are built with small gaps between sections. She learns that the gaps allow the metal to ___ in summer without buckling.
statement: A student investigates why metal railings on a bridge are built with small gaps between sections. She learns that the gaps allow the metal to expand in summer without buckling.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A pilot is flying at 35,000 feet and notices the outside temperature is -60 degrees Celsius. The pilot knows that temperature ___ with altitude in the troposphere.
statement: A pilot is flying at 35,000 feet and notices the outside temperature is -60 degrees Celsius. The pilot knows that temperature decreases with altitude in the troposphere.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A teacher is explaining why wet clothes feel cold on a windy day. She says that wind increases the rate of ___ of the water in the clothes, carrying heat away from the body.
statement: A teacher is explaining why wet clothes feel cold on a windy day. She says that wind increases the rate of evaporation of the water in the clothes, carrying heat away from the body.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying genetics learns that eye color is determined by multiple genes, making it a ___ trait.
statement: A student studying genetics learns that eye color is determined by multiple genes, making it a polygenic trait.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A group of children is playing tug-of-war. One team is much heavier than the other and always wins. The teacher explains that the heavier team exerts more ___ on the rope.
statement: A group of children is playing tug-of-war. One team is much heavier than the other and always wins. The teacher explains that the heavier team exerts more force on the rope.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student examining pond water under a microscope sees a tiny single-celled organism moving using small, hair-like structures. Her teacher tells her these structures are called ___ and help the organism move and feed.
statement: A student examining pond water under a microscope sees a tiny single-celled organism moving using small, hair-like structures. Her teacher tells her these structures are called cilia and help the organism move and feed.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A volcanologist measuring gas emissions from an active volcano notices a sudden increase in sulfur dioxide output. She warns that this may indicate that magma is moving upward toward the surface, possibly signaling an ___ eruption.
statement: A volcanologist measuring gas emissions from an active volcano notices a sudden increase in sulfur dioxide output. She warns that this may indicate that magma is moving upward toward the surface, possibly signaling an imminent eruption.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student reads that before humans were able to make bread, they could only eat unleavened flatbreads. Leavened bread requires yeast, which makes the dough rise by producing ___ gas.
statement: A student reads that before humans were able to make bread, they could only eat unleavened flatbreads. Leavened bread requires yeast, which makes the dough rise by producing carbon dioxide gas.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying the Moon's phases realizes that the Moon doesn't produce its own light. The light we see from the Moon is actually sunlight ___ off its surface.
statement: A student studying the Moon's phases realizes that the Moon doesn't produce its own light. The light we see from the Moon is actually sunlight reflected off its surface.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A doctor advising a patient about bone health explains that regular weight-bearing exercise helps build stronger bones because the mechanical ___ on the bones stimulates new bone growth.
statement: A doctor advising a patient about bone health explains that regular weight-bearing exercise helps build stronger bones because the mechanical stress on the bones stimulates new bone growth.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student learning about evolution discovers that the wings of bats, the flippers of whales, and the arms of humans all have very similar bone structures. These structures evolved from a common ___ but have different functions.
statement: A student learning about evolution discovers that the wings of bats, the flippers of whales, and the arms of humans all have very similar bone structures. These structures evolved from a common ancestor but have different functions.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer designing a parachute for a skydiver knows that a larger canopy creates more air ___, which slows the descent more effectively.
statement: An engineer designing a parachute for a skydiver knows that a larger canopy creates more air resistance, which slows the descent more effectively.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A botanist studying seed dispersal finds that dandelion seeds have a feathery structure that allows them to be carried by ___.
statement: A botanist studying seed dispersal finds that dandelion seeds have a feathery structure that allows them to be carried by wind.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A scientist investigating the origins of the Moon proposes that it was formed when a large object collided with the early Earth. Evidence for this is that the Moon's composition is similar to Earth's ___ layer.
statement: A scientist investigating the origins of the Moon proposes that it was formed when a large object collided with the early Earth. Evidence for this is that the Moon's composition is similar to Earth's mantle layer.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A city engineer notices that roads in cold climates develop potholes faster than in warm climates. This is because water gets into cracks in the road and then ___ in winter, expanding and making the cracks bigger.
statement: A city engineer notices that roads in cold climates develop potholes faster than in warm climates. This is because water gets into cracks in the road and then freezes in winter, expanding and making the cracks bigger.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student observes that when she places her hand near a hot stove, she can feel the heat without touching it. This heat transfer through air is called ___.
statement: A student observes that when she places her hand near a hot stove, she can feel the heat without touching it. This heat transfer through air is called convection and radiation.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A doctor explains to a patient that their arteries have narrowed due to a buildup of fatty deposits. This condition reduces blood flow and can cause a heart ___ if the artery becomes completely blocked.
statement: A doctor explains to a patient that their arteries have narrowed due to a buildup of fatty deposits. This condition reduces blood flow and can cause a heart attack if the artery becomes completely blocked.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying tidal patterns near a coastline finds that some areas experience two high tides per day. The tides are primarily driven by the gravitational pull of the ___ on Earth's oceans.
statement: A student studying tidal patterns near a coastline finds that some areas experience two high tides per day. The tides are primarily driven by the gravitational pull of the Moon on Earth's oceans.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer designing a dam to generate electricity explains that the greater the height of water behind the dam, the more ___ energy the water has, and the more electricity can be generated.
statement: An engineer designing a dam to generate electricity explains that the greater the height of water behind the dam, the more potential energy the water has, and the more electricity can be generated.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying Earth's layers discovers that seismologists can map Earth's interior by measuring how seismic waves change ___ and direction as they pass through different layers.
statement: A student studying Earth's layers discovers that seismologists can map Earth's interior by measuring how seismic waves change speed and direction as they pass through different layers.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A researcher tracking a flu epidemic finds that the number of cases doubles every three days at first. She says the epidemic is spreading ___ because each infected person infects more than one other person.
statement: A researcher tracking a flu epidemic finds that the number of cases doubles every three days at first. She says the epidemic is spreading exponentially because each infected person infects more than one other person.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student is learning about how the eye works. She discovers that the image formed on the retina is upside down, but the ___ flips the image so we perceive the world right-side up.
statement: A student is learning about how the eye works. She discovers that the image formed on the retina is upside down, but the brain flips the image so we perceive the world right-side up.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A fisherman notices that the lobsters he catches near an industrial plant are smaller than those caught further away. A biologist suggests that ___ from the plant may be disrupting the lobsters' hormone systems and preventing normal growth.
statement: A fisherman notices that the lobsters he catches near an industrial plant are smaller than those caught further away. A biologist suggests that pollution from the plant may be disrupting the lobsters' hormone systems and preventing normal growth.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student discovers that ancient Egyptians used ramps to move heavy stone blocks used to build the pyramids. A ramp is a simple machine that reduces the ___ needed to move an object by increasing the distance over which the force is applied.
statement: A student discovers that ancient Egyptians used ramps to move heavy stone blocks used to build the pyramids. A ramp is a simple machine that reduces the force needed to move an object by increasing the distance over which the force is applied.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A scientist studying deforestation in tropical regions finds that areas of cleared rainforest have higher local temperatures than forested areas. This is because trees cool their environment through ___ and by providing shade.
statement: A scientist studying deforestation in tropical regions finds that areas of cleared rainforest have higher local temperatures than forested areas. This is because trees cool their environment through transpiration and by providing shade.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student investigating the properties of different soils finds that sandy soil drains water very quickly but clay soil holds water for a long time. She concludes that plants that need consistent moisture are better suited to ___ soil.
statement: A student investigating the properties of different soils finds that sandy soil drains water very quickly but clay soil holds water for a long time. She concludes that plants that need consistent moisture are better suited to clay soil.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An astronaut is trying to describe to school students why things float in the International Space Station. She explains that it is not because there is no gravity, but because the station and everything in it are in a continuous state of ___ around Earth.
statement: An astronaut is trying to describe to school students why things float in the International Space Station. She explains that it is not because there is no gravity, but because the station and everything in it are in a continuous state of freefall around Earth.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying animal migration learns that Arctic terns travel from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back each year, a round trip of nearly 70,000 km. They make this journey to take advantage of the long ___ days at each pole.
statement: A student studying animal migration learns that Arctic terns travel from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back each year, a round trip of nearly 70,000 km. They make this journey to take advantage of the long summer days at each pole.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A chemist explains that when two acidic compounds combine, they do not cancel each other out; only an acid and a ___ can neutralize each other.
statement: A chemist explains that when two acidic compounds combine, they do not cancel each other out; only an acid and a base can neutralize each other.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student notices that the edge of a knife becomes dull after repeated use. The knife becomes sharp again when it is ___ because this re-aligns the edge and removes material.
statement: A student notices that the edge of a knife becomes dull after repeated use. The knife becomes sharp again when it is sharpened because this re-aligns the edge and removes material.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A child watching a campfire is fascinated by the different colors of the flames. The teacher explains that the color of the flame depends on the ___ of the material being burned and the temperature.
statement: A child watching a campfire is fascinated by the different colors of the flames. The teacher explains that the color of the flame depends on the chemical composition of the material being burned and the temperature.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student performing a titration experiment adds drops of sodium hydroxide to hydrochloric acid with an indicator dye. When the indicator changes color, she knows the acid has been completely ___ by the base.
statement: A student performing a titration experiment adds drops of sodium hydroxide to hydrochloric acid with an indicator dye. When the indicator changes color, she knows the acid has been completely neutralized by the base.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A scientist studying a population of insects finds that introducing a pesticide initially reduces the population dramatically. However, after several generations, the population recovers because the surviving insects passed on their ___ genes to their offspring.
statement: A scientist studying a population of insects finds that introducing a pesticide initially reduces the population dramatically. However, after several generations, the population recovers because the surviving insects passed on their resistant genes to their offspring.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A child is playing with a spinning hoop and finds that once it is spinning fast, it stays upright on its own. She discovers that a spinning object resists changes to its orientation due to a property called ___ momentum.
statement: A child is playing with a spinning hoop and finds that once it is spinning fast, it stays upright on its own. She discovers that a spinning object resists changes to its orientation due to a property called angular momentum.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An ecologist studying a prairie ecosystem counts populations of hawks, rabbits, and grasses each year. She finds that when rabbit populations increase, hawk populations soon follow, and then rabbit populations fall again. This pattern is known as ___ cycle dynamics.
statement: An ecologist studying a prairie ecosystem counts populations of hawks, rabbits, and grasses each year. She finds that when rabbit populations increase, hawk populations soon follow, and then rabbit populations fall again. This pattern is known as predator-prey cycle dynamics.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student learns that the loudness of a sound decreases as you move further from the source. She is standing 1 meter from a speaker and then moves to 4 meters away. The sound will seem considerably ___ at the greater distance.
statement: A student learns that the loudness of a sound decreases as you move further from the source. She is standing 1 meter from a speaker and then moves to 4 meters away. The sound will seem considerably quieter at the greater distance.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A gardener notices that her tomato plants grow much larger and produce more fruit when she adds compost to the soil. The compost improves the soil because it provides ___ that the plants need to grow.
statement: A gardener notices that her tomato plants grow much larger and produce more fruit when she adds compost to the soil. The compost improves the soil because it provides nutrients that the plants need to grow.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student doing a chemistry experiment carefully heats a blue copper sulfate crystal. The crystal turns white and water droplets form on the cooler part of the test tube. She concludes that the blue color was due to water of ___ held within the crystal.
statement: A student doing a chemistry experiment carefully heats a blue copper sulfate crystal. The crystal turns white and water droplets form on the cooler part of the test tube. She concludes that the blue color was due to water of crystallization held within the crystal.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A wildlife photographer notices that a ptarmigan bird has white feathers in winter but brown feathers in summer. She determines this seasonal color change helps the bird avoid ___ in each season's environment.
statement: A wildlife photographer notices that a ptarmigan bird has white feathers in winter but brown feathers in summer. She determines this seasonal color change helps the bird avoid predators in each season's environment.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A geologist studying rock outcrops in a valley notices that the oldest rocks are at the ___ of the exposed layers, according to the principle of superposition.
statement: A geologist studying rock outcrops in a valley notices that the oldest rocks are at the bottom of the exposed layers, according to the principle of superposition.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An electrical engineer is testing two resistors in a circuit. When she connects them in series, the total resistance ___, making the current smaller.
statement: An electrical engineer is testing two resistors in a circuit. When she connects them in series, the total resistance increases, making the current smaller.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A zoologist studying whale communication finds that whale songs can travel hundreds of kilometers through the ocean. This long-distance communication is possible because sound travels much ___ in water than in air.
statement: A zoologist studying whale communication finds that whale songs can travel hundreds of kilometers through the ocean. This long-distance communication is possible because sound travels much faster in water than in air.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student investigating melting and freezing uses a thermometer to record the temperature of ice as it heats up. She finds that the temperature stays constant at 0 degrees Celsius while the ice is melting. She concludes that the heat energy is being used to ___ the bonds between water molecules rather than raise the temperature.
statement: A student investigating melting and freezing uses a thermometer to record the temperature of ice as it heats up. She finds that the temperature stays constant at 0 degrees Celsius while the ice is melting. She concludes that the heat energy is being used to break the bonds between water molecules rather than raise the temperature.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student researching ocean animals discovers that sharks must keep swimming continuously to force water through their gills. Unlike fish, most sharks lack a swim bladder and will also ___ if they stop swimming.
statement: A student researching ocean animals discovers that sharks must keep swimming continuously to force water through their gills. Unlike fish, most sharks lack a swim bladder and will also sink if they stop swimming.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A biology student is observing cells under a microscope. She places a plant cell and an animal cell next to each other. One distinguishing feature she notices is that the plant cell has a cell ___, while the animal cell does not.
statement: A biology student is observing cells under a microscope. She places a plant cell and an animal cell next to each other. One distinguishing feature she notices is that the plant cell has a cell wall, while the animal cell does not.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An engineer designing a racing bicycle uses lightweight materials such as carbon fiber for the frame. The primary reason for this is to reduce the bicycle's ___ so less energy is needed to accelerate it.
statement: An engineer designing a racing bicycle uses lightweight materials such as carbon fiber for the frame. The primary reason for this is to reduce the bicycle's mass so less energy is needed to accelerate it.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A microbiologist studying bacterial resistance finds that hospitals have increasingly high rates of antibiotic-resistant bacteria. She warns that overuse of antibiotics in medicine and agriculture is ___ the problem.
statement: A microbiologist studying bacterial resistance finds that hospitals have increasingly high rates of antibiotic-resistant bacteria. She warns that overuse of antibiotics in medicine and agriculture is worsening the problem.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A physics student is experimenting with magnets and finds that when she heats a magnet to high temperatures, it loses its ___ properties. This is because heat disrupts the alignment of magnetic domains.
statement: A physics student is experimenting with magnets and finds that when she heats a magnet to high temperatures, it loses its magnetic properties. This is because heat disrupts the alignment of magnetic domains.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student performing an experiment fills two identical containers with the same mass of sand and water. He places both in the sun and records the temperature every ten minutes. The sand heats up much faster than the water, demonstrating that sand has a lower heat ___.
statement: A student performing an experiment fills two identical containers with the same mass of sand and water. He places both in the sun and records the temperature every ten minutes. The sand heats up much faster than the water, demonstrating that sand has a lower heat capacity.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A biologist studying symbiosis in tropical fish notices that small cleaning fish set up stations on the reef. Larger fish, even natural predators, come to these stations and let the cleaning fish eat parasites from their skin. The cleaning fish get food; the larger fish get rid of ___.
statement: A biologist studying symbiosis in tropical fish notices that small cleaning fish set up stations on the reef. Larger fish, even natural predators, come to these stations and let the cleaning fish eat parasites from their skin. The cleaning fish get food; the larger fish get rid of parasites.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student conducting an investigation into plant growth adds fertilizer to one group of plants but not another. After four weeks, the fertilized plants are significantly taller. She concludes the fertilizer provided the ___ needed for faster growth.
statement: A student conducting an investigation into plant growth adds fertilizer to one group of plants but not another. After four weeks, the fertilized plants are significantly taller. She concludes the fertilizer provided the nutrients needed for faster growth.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A nurse explains to a diabetic patient why it is important to monitor blood sugar levels carefully. She says that without enough ___, cells throughout the body cannot get the glucose they need to function properly.
statement: A nurse explains to a diabetic patient why it is important to monitor blood sugar levels carefully. She says that without enough insulin, cells throughout the body cannot get the glucose they need to function properly.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying geology reads that the Himalayan mountain range is still growing by about 5 millimeters per year. This is because the Indian plate continues to ___ into the Eurasian plate.
statement: A student studying geology reads that the Himalayan mountain range is still growing by about 5 millimeters per year. This is because the Indian plate continues to collide into the Eurasian plate.

subject: General Knowledge
question: An environmental scientist studying river pollution discovers that a chemical factory is discharging waste into a river upstream of a town. People downstream are getting sick. She identifies the factory as the ___ of the contamination.
statement: An environmental scientist studying river pollution discovers that a chemical factory is discharging waste into a river upstream of a town. People downstream are getting sick. She identifies the factory as the source of the contamination.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying electricity builds a simple generator by rotating a coil of wire inside a magnetic field. She discovers that the faster she rotates the coil, the ___ the voltage produced.
statement: A student studying electricity builds a simple generator by rotating a coil of wire inside a magnetic field. She discovers that the faster she rotates the coil, the higher the voltage produced.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A marine biologist discovers that sea turtles return to the same beach where they were born to lay their eggs decades later. Scientists believe turtles navigate using Earth's ___ field.
statement: A marine biologist discovers that sea turtles return to the same beach where they were born to lay their eggs decades later. Scientists believe turtles navigate using Earth's magnetic field.

subject: General Knowledge
question: A student studying genetics learns about hemophilia, a condition in which blood does not clot properly. He discovers that hemophilia is more common in males than females because it is carried on the ___ chromosome.
